newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates fall on loose liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates fall on loose liquidity.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates fell further at midday on Wednesday as major state banks continued to liquidate excess funds, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate was at 4.598 percent against Tuesday's 4.778 end, with 30-day commercial paper down to 4.70-4.75 from 4.75-4.80.
Dealers expected liquidity to remain loose unless the central bank moves to mop up the funds through NCD issues.
The bond yields rose slightly in late morning trade, with the 10-year 84/1 bond yield at 5.659-660 and the seven-year 84/2 bond yield at 5.585. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
